evidence.curator_note: DETECTION CONSISTENCY: this precursor is the SAME ion as the product of IMS8-EQ8.81a (the (M-CH3OH)+. phenylhexenal radical cation, curator-computed m/z 174.1039), which the p197 text reports as an observed peak ('yielding (M-CH3OH)+. and (M-76)+. peaks ... very useful for identifying substitution at C-6'). detected is therefore set true here as well, matching 8.81a; it was previously false, which made the two records disagree about whether the same ion is observed. Bottom row of Equation 8.81, a SEPARATE scheme sharing the equation number: the page redraws the (M - CH3OH)+. enal ion of IMS8-EQ8.81a (the two structures are joined by the identity sign '|||' = 'is identical to') in a chair-like conformation and lets it dissociate further over an arrow labelled 'rH' above and 'i' below, giving the (M - 76)+. ion plus the enol CH2=CH-OH. The precursor is therefore the m/z 174 FRAGMENT ion, not the molecular ion (ms_context.adduct = null). Mechanism as drawn: the carbonyl O+. abstracts the gamma-H (on the allylic C-4) through the classic six-membered McLafferty arrangement, then the C2-C3 bond is cleaved heterolytically toward the enol so the charge MIGRATES to the hydrocarbon ('i'). Book draws 3 arcs; moves <1,2,5> are drawn - <1> fishhook from the O+. odd electron pointing at the gamma-H, <2> fishhook from the C4-H bond pointing at the O, <5> a full solid-headed (two-barbed) arrow from the C2-C3 bond to the forming C1=C2 bond; moves <3> and <4> are implicit and not drawn on the page: <3> is the implicit homolysis hook that leaves the second C4-H electron on C-4 (required for electron balance, and drawn in the product as the '.' on that carbon) and <4> is the carbonyl pi pair collapsing onto oxygen (required because the drawn neutral is the C-O SINGLE-bonded enol CH2=CH-OH with a neutral OH). The product ion is drawn LOCALIZED as a distonic species - '.' on the former gamma carbon (C-4) and '+' on the terminal CH2 that lost the enol (C-3) - and is encoded exactly in that drawn resonance form; it is one localized form of the delocalized 1-phenyl-1,3-butadiene radical cation C10H10+. that the mass label '(M - 76)+.' denotes.

rule_index.json 'by_equation' has NO entry for 8.81 (chapter-8 keys stop at 8.14, German-edition numbering), so no MØD rule variable is cross-linked. Checked rather than assumed: IMS_8_9_1_CH3/IMS_8_9_1_OCH3 are the indexed 'rH onto C=O+.' rules, but their DFS builds a conjugated DIENOL ion (the H lands on the carbonyl O and the charge stays with the oxygenated fragment, no C-C cleavage in the same rule), whereas this step cleaves C2-C3 with charge migration to the hydrocarbon and expels the neutral enol; IMS_8_11/IMS_8_13 ('Field Rule' rH) transfer an H to an oxonium O+ of an already-cleaved ion and are also a different reaction. No indexed rule matches.

The scheme labels the product ion '(M - 76)+.' and the prose calls it a peak ('yielding (M - CH3OH)+. and (M - 76)+. peaks (Meyerson and Leitch 1966)'), but NO numeric m/z and NO intensity is printed on the page; detected=true rests on those labels only and relative_intensity is omitted. observed_mz 130.0777 is curator-computed (C10H10+., monoisotopic mass of the cation with the electron mass subtracted) for the drawn methyl 6-phenylhexanoate instantiation whose M+. is 206.1301; 206.1301 - 76.0524 (CH3OH + C2H4O = 32.0262 + 44.0262) = 130.0777, consistent with the printed '(M - 76)' label. The page names no ionization or activation experiment for this consecutive dissociation: it is a source-formed EI fragment decomposing further, not a CAD or metastable-ion measurement, so activation_method says so explicitly and electron_energy_ev is left null.

ms_context.activation_method: consecutive unimolecular dissociation of the source-formed (M - CH3OH)+• EI fragment ion (no CAD/MI experiment named on the page)
